description:
Music for Sleepless Nights | Slow Tanpura | 1.5 Hours

It's late, and your mind still won't shut off.

The thoughts keep circling — the day you just had, the day coming tomorrow — and the harder you try to sleep, the more awake you feel. You don't need another melody to follow. You need something to let go into. Something with no beginning and no end, just a steady, unbroken hum you can sink beneath.

That's what the tanpura does. It's the drone — no melody, no rhythm, nothing for the mind to grab onto. Just a slow, cyclic plucking of strings and the warm shimmer of overtones rising and folding back into each other, on and on. This recording is tuned to the deep, weighted color of Raga Darbari — the great late-night raga, grave and bottomless — so even a drone carries the gravity of the small hours.

Lay it under the dark, let the hum fill the room, and stop trying. Let the night itself do the rest.

🎵 What you'll hear:
- Tanpura — the Indian drone, a continuous resonant wash of overtones
- Slow, cyclic plucking of strings with the soft jawari buzz that makes it shimmer
- The deep, weighted color of Raga Darbari — the late-night raga, grave and bottomless
- No melody, no rhythm, no tabla — nothing to follow, only something to sink into
- 90 unbroken minutes at 432Hz tuning, with a gentle delta undertone

⏱ Chapters
0:00    Settling into the dark
20:00   The hum deepens
45:00   Letting go
70:00   Drifting under
85:00   Stillness

🧠 How to use:
Dim the lights and lie down. Set the volume low — just enough to fill the edges of the room. Don't listen for anything. There's no melody to wait for. Let the drone become the background of the dark and let your attention dissolve into it.

⏱ Best for:
• Falling asleep when the mind won't stop
• Insomnia and restless, wakeful nights
• Lying down to let go at the end of the day
• A continuous, melody-free sleep background
• Deep rest without anything to track or follow

production_spec.loop_seam: 10s in / 30s out, Suno extend 3-4x → loop in post to fill 90 min
production_spec.notes: Tanpura is a pure DRONE instrument — the continuous Sa-Pa-Sa cyclic plucking of strings, no melody and no rhythm. This is the channel's dedicated sleep/insomnia tool. Raga Darbari's deep komal-dominant character lends late-night gravity even to a melody-free drone bed — the heaviness reads as the small hours. NO tabla, NO percussion, NO melody-driving instrument — the drone must carry the whole 90 min on its own. Delta binaural (2.5Hz beat, ~180Hz carrier) for genuine sleep induction — this is the ONE brief this week using Delta (sleep lane). LUFS -18 — the quietest target in the catalog, correct for a sleep ship played low in a dark room. EMOTIONAL TAG ROTATION (3 metaphors): clip 1: 'like the night itself humming you to sleep' · clip 2: 'a steady hum with no beginning and no end, just something to sink beneath' · clip 3: 'the dark room slowly dissolving, nothing left to hold onto'. 90min = 3-4 Suno clips of the drone + loop extension in post; since there is no melody, loop seams are very forgiving.
